messages:
nina: Quick follow-up on onboarding: propose a probe-orchestration layer that schedules lightweight runtime-specific probes post-ingest rather than one big bench run. keep inline smoke only.

cale: I like it. how do we ensure probes cover runtime kv-cache and quant paths?

nina: probes are tagged with runtime_profile (quant,seqlen,batch). orchestrator picks top-N profiles from model metadata and fans out small probe jobs (N=100 each) prioritized by seqlen rarity and recent-prod signals.

jord: sounds cheaper. checkpointing requirement? if a probe job fails we should resume specific probe ids, not restart the whole model job.

nina: yep  store per-probe state in registry (probe_id, model_ver, cursor, status). resume picks unfinished probe ids. also attach minimal repro snippets to findings.

cale: policy knobs? we still need a way to block if a critical probe fails.

nina: add org policy: block_on_critical=true/false. default false. if true, fail ingest until critical probes pass or timeout. also support a short canary window to route 1-5% traffic while probes run.

infra-bot: note: bench worker quota applies. coordinate heavy probe waves with infra.

jord: action items: nina draft short RFC with orchestrator API + probe state model, cale prototype probe sampler script, i'll sketch registry schema. sync Fri.
